text:
morgan: Quick follow-up from the GPU OOM postmortem — consolidating remediation ownership + timelines. Full PM: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4021 (see 'Follow-ups' section). Need people to confirm owners and ETA for: quota request, scheduler tuning, autoscaler headroom, validation plan.

priya: I can own the cloud quota request (AWS/GCP). Will open the support case today and aim for quota bump in 10 business days. Adding the support ticket link in the doc.

sam: I’ll take scheduler-level changes / placement policy tuning. Proposed changes: lower preemption threshold to 0.65, prefer spreading by GPU-type, and add a soft-limit on pod creation when pending>20. I want to smoke test in staging first.

sam: quick example HPA/autoscaler snippet I want to try in staging:```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: llm-worker-hpa
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: llm-worker
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 12
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: gpu_utilization
      target:
        type: AverageValue
        averageValue: "65"
```

lila: For headroom planning I propose a simple rule: keep region headroom = max(2 GPUs, 20% of active pool) per region, plus 1 extra reserved slot for emergency bursts. That should cover most burst patterns we saw. I’ll model this with last 30 days of cntr usage and post numbers by EOD tomorrow.

jonah: Can we add an SLO/alert for pending queue > 15 for >5m + average latency increase of >25%? We missed early warning on the last incident. I can add alerts to perf-monitoring and a dashboard.

alex: I’ll own rollout verification and the post-deploy checklist. Plan: canary 10% -> 50% -> full over 24h with automated rollback if token latency spikes >30% or queue length grows. I’ll script the smoke tests and put the checklist in the doc.

priya: FYI, quota requests may need justification doc for expected sustained vCPU/GPU usage — I’ll draft and attach. If cloud ops needs committed spend, we’ll escalate.

morgan: Notes on priority/timeline: quota (PRI: high, ETA 10bd), scheduler tuning (PRI: high, staging tests 3d, rollout 1w), headroom model (PRI: medium, analysis 2d), alerts/dashboard (PRI: high, ETA 2d), rollout verification (owner: alex, ETA 3d).

sam: One more: can we change scheduler to avoid packing small pods on the same card when sequence_len>1024? That pattern chewed cache and triggered OOM cascade. I’ll add a predicate for sequence-aware placement.

lila: If we adopt sequence-aware placement we should track cache-hit % and per-GPU kv-cache growth — I’ll add metrics to the dashboard.

incident-bot: Action items added to postmortem tracker: INC-4021-FU-1 (quota - priya), INC-4021-FU-2 (scheduler tuning - sam), INC-4021-FU-3 (headroom plan - lila), INC-4021-FU-4 (alerts - jonah), INC-4021-FU-5 (rollout verification - alex).

deploy-bot: PR #1892 (autoscaler: respect headroom buffer) merged to staging at 2025-10-22T14:03:00Z.

morgan: Thanks all. Please update the ticket when you have a public ETA and mark 'in-progress' in the postmortem tracker. I’ll follow up in the weekly ops sync. :thumbsup:
